metaShifts.description: After the massive agility carry buffs in 7.40b, this patch applies targeted nerfs to prevent overcorrection. Spectre, Phantom Lancer, Phantom Assassin, and Clinkz all receive meaningful nerfs, while Terrorblade gets mixed changes. This suggests the previous buffs were too aggressive and the meta is being fine-tuned rather than allowing a complete agility carry takeover.

Continuing the trend from 7.40b, traditional tanky offlaners (Axe, Slardar, Tidehunter, Timbersaw) receive further durability nerfs. However, scaling offlaners like Lone Druid and Pangolier get buffs, reinforcing the shift toward offlaners who can become late-game threats rather than pure utility tanks.

Multiple illusion-based synergies are being systematically removed: Broodmother's Incapacitating Bite, Abaddon's Curse of Avernus, and Terrorblade's Demon Zeal no longer work with illusions. This reduces the power of illusion-based strategies and item synergies, particularly affecting heroes who relied on illusion multiplication of effects.

Tempo-controlling mid heroes receive mixed adjustments: Bloodseeker and Ember Spirit get nerfed, while utility mids like Batrider and Rubick receive buffs. This suggests a move away from high-tempo, aggressive mid heroes toward more strategic, team-fight oriented mid laners.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Lone Druid's base agility increase (+2) and damage buffs significantly improve his farming speed and early game presence. The longer Savage Roar duration makes him more effective in team fights, synergizing well with aura items like Radiance and AC that benefit from extended engagement time.

Slark's Saltwater Shiv buffs to regen and speed steal at higher levels create stronger synergy with stat-based items. The improved scaling makes items like SnY and Manta more valuable as they amplify his enhanced stat steal mechanics.

Despite the Demon Zeal nerf, Terrorblade's reduced Conjure Image mana costs and Sunder cooldown buffs make him more sustainable in extended fights. This synergizes well with tanky items like Heart and Skadi that allow him to stay in fights longer to utilize his improved spell cycling.

The significant Jingu Mastery damage buffs (+15 at max level) create stronger synergy with damage amplification items. Desolator's armor reduction and Daedalus crits become more impactful when combined with MK's enhanced bonus damage from Jingu stacks.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The Doppelganger mana cost increase (+20) and Illusory Armaments damage reduction significantly hurt PL's early-mid game power spike. This makes the traditional Diffusal/Manta timing weaker as PL has less mana efficiency and his illusions deal less damage during the crucial 15-25 minute window.

The massive Skeleton Walk building damage penalty increase (25% to 75%) destroys Clinkz's split-push potential with damage items. Desolator and Orchid builds that relied on quickly taking towers with skeleton archers are now severely weakened, forcing a complete playstyle shift.

The removal of Incapacitating Bite from illusions eliminates a key synergy with Manta Style and illusion runes. Previously, Brood's illusions could apply the movement/attack speed slow, making Manta a strong fighting item. This synergy is now completely removed.

Multiple nerfs (strength gain, health talent, illusion damage talent) reduce Spectre's late-game scaling potential. The traditional Radiance/Heart build becomes less effective as Spectre's illusions deal less damage and she has less raw HP, reducing the impact of these expensive late-game items.
